expectations.evidence: Concise code, sparse comments, confident shortcuts (BYPASS_ENABLED env check, stub user for dev). Assumes reader knows Express patterns. Comments are terse and practical ('stub user for local dev').

Proper type imports, union types for Role, discriminated union pattern for verifyToken result ('error' in result), optional chaining (req.user?.roles), nullish coalescing (opts.bypass ?? BYPASS_ENABLED).
Uses type-only imports for Express types. No unnecessary libraries. Imports reflect actual usage without over-importing.

Dev bypass is pragmatic (not textbook). Error messages are terse ('missing auth token', 'insufficient permissions'). _authTs timestamp addition shows organic evolution. authWithRoles convenience shows real usage pattern.
'missing auth token', 'unauthenticated', 'insufficient permissions' — lowercase, terse, developer-oriented. Comment: 'don't leak which roles are required — just deny'.
